# poiema-ui — full context

Poiema design system (proprietary, Poiema use only): monochrome, tactile, editorial. Framework-agnostic CSS tokens + pm-* component classes, tiny optional JS behaviors, Tailwind v4 theme, and agent context (AGENTS.md, skills) so AI builds in the same voice.


---

# Poiema UI — instructions for coding agents

You are building UI with the **Poiema design system** (`poiema-ui`). It is **proprietary to Poiema** (see `LICENSE`): use it only in Poiema's own projects. Never publish it to npm or a public CDN, and never copy it into projects for anyone else. Follow these rules whenever you create or change anything users see: markup, styles, copy or motion. Details live in `docs/` next to this file (in an app: `node_modules/poiema-ui/docs/`).

## The essence
A **quiet gray gallery**. Huge, tight, **lowercase** type does the shouting. Soft 40px cards and pills. **No hue in the interface**: color lives only in tactile objects (clay, plaster, grass, iron, diamond). The voice is **sincere and communal** ("we", "our family"), and it gets to the point. Motion **rises and settles**; objects float.

## Setup (once per app)
- CSS: `import 'poiema-ui/css'` (or a self-hosted copy of `dist/poiema.min.css`). Tailwind v4: see `docs/frameworks.md`.
- Font: Inter Tight 400–900 (`poiema-ui/fonts.css`, `next/font` with `variable: '--pm-font-sans'`, or `@fontsource-variable/inter-tight`).
- Behaviors (optional): call `init()` from `poiema-ui` once on the client at the app root, or load `poiema-ui/auto`.

## Hard rules
1. **Use the `pm-*` classes and `--pm-*` tokens.** Don't invent colors, radii, shadows or fonts. If something is missing, compose it from tokens.
2. **Grayscale chrome only.** Backgrounds: `--pm-canvas` (page), `.pm-card`, `--pm-surface` (paper). Text: `--pm-ink`, `--pm-ink-2`, `--pm-label`, `--pm-muted`. Material colors (`--pm-clay`, `--pm-grass`…) are for objects, illustrations and data only, never buttons, links or backgrounds. Errors use `--pm-danger`, confirmations `--pm-success`.
3. **Never use pure white pages.** The page is `#e2e2e2`; cards are paper.
4. **Display headlines are lowercase and end with a period** (questions end with `?`): `<h2 class="pm-h1">your projects.</h2>`. Eyebrows, tags and alert titles are small, bold, UPPERCASE via CSS.
5. **One echo per display line:** wrap one phrase in `.pm-muted` (the gray middle beat): `plan. <span class="pm-muted">focus.</span> finish.`
6. **Soft geometry:** cards 40px (`.pm-card`), callouts 28px, alerts and tiles 24px, buttons/chips/inputs pill. Numbers in rings (`.pm-ring`), bullets are diamonds (`.pm-list`).
7. **Key-message callouts only on request.** The reference page briefed leaders, so every section closed with a `.pm-callout` labeled "The message that must be clear" / "Mensagem que precisa ficar clara". Poiema products mostly speak to consumers: don't add that callout unless the user asks for it.
8. **Rhythm by inversion:** alternate `.pm-card` and `.pm-card[data-theme="dark"]`; use ink boxes (`.pm-inverse`) and the marquee band for punctuation, not color.
9. **Motion:** `data-pm-reveal` on sections/cards, `.pm-float` + `data-pm-tilt` on objects only, curve `--pm-ease`. No bounce, no spin, no parallax. Reduced motion is handled; keep it that way.
10. **Copy:** verb-first buttons (`Create project`), past-participle feedback (`Saved ✓`), calm alerts (`Attention` / `Important` + why), "we/our", no hype words, no emoji, at most one `!` (the closing line). Full guide: `docs/voice.md`.
11. **Accessibility:** keep semantic HTML, labels on fields, `aria-invalid` for errors, `aria-current`/`aria-selected` for active pills, alt text on objects (`alt=""` if decorative), visible focus (already styled).

## Cheat-sheet

```
page        body (canvas) > .pm-topbar + main > .pm-section > .pm-container
hero        .pm-hero(.pm-hero--pillars) > .pm-eyebrow + .pm-lockup|.pm-display + .pm-cluster(.pm-chip…) + .pm-lead + .pm-scroll-cue
title       .pm-section-head > .pm-ring + .pm-h1 + p
card        .pm-card | [data-theme=dark] | --outline | --compact      tile: .pm-tile
feature     .pm-card.pm-feature(--flip) > .pm-feature__media[data-pm-tilt] > img.pm-object.pm-float + .pm-feature__body
callout     .pm-callout > .pm-eyebrow + p (+ p.pm-callout__big)
alert       .pm-alert(--danger|--success) > strong.pm-alert__title + p
lists       .pm-list (◆) | --check (✓ must keep) | --open (○ your call) | --numbered
buttons     .pm-btn | --soft | --outline | --ghost | --danger | --sm | --lg | --icon | --block | --rich(__icon __text __arrow)
chips       .pm-chip | --solid | --outline     .pm-tag (outlined uppercase)
nav         .pm-pillnav(--sticky) > a|button (+ .pm-ring--sm), active = aria-current / aria-selected
data        .pm-stat(__value __label) .pm-numeral .pm-ticket(__main __dates __month __side __row) .pm-table .pm-progress
forms       .pm-field > .pm-label + .pm-input|.pm-select|.pm-textarea + .pm-hint|.pm-error ; .pm-choice > .pm-check|.pm-radio|.pm-switch
overlay     dialog.pm-dialog (+ data-pm-open="id", data-pm-close) ; toast('Saved ✓')
layout      .pm-container .pm-section .pm-band .pm-stack(--sm|--lg|--xl) .pm-cluster .pm-grid(--2|--3) .pm-split .pm-ruled
type        .pm-eyebrow .pm-display .pm-h1 .pm-h2 .pm-h3 .pm-h4 .pm-lead .pm-body .pm-small .pm-numeral .pm-prose
utility     .pm-muted .pm-ink-2 .pm-nums .pm-center .pm-measure .pm-lower .pm-sr-only .pm-inverse .pm-lift
themes      data-theme="light|dark|auto" on any element
motion [JS] data-pm-reveal(="fade"|"scale") data-pm-stagger data-pm-tilt data-pm-cycle data-pm-copy data-pm-countdown
```

Key tokens: `--pm-canvas --pm-surface --pm-card --pm-ink --pm-ink-2 --pm-label --pm-muted --pm-line --pm-danger --pm-success --pm-font --pm-text-h1 --pm-radius-xl --pm-gutter --pm-section --pm-ease --pm-shadow-float`. Full list: `docs/tokens.md`.

## Before you finish a UI task, check
- [ ] No hex colors or hues outside tokens; no Tailwind default palette; no pure white page.
- [ ] Every display headline is lowercase and ends with `.`/`?`; one `.pm-muted` echo at most per line.
- [ ] No key-message `.pm-callout` unless the user asked for one.
- [ ] Radii are 40/28/24/pill; numbers in rings; bullets are diamonds.
- [ ] Motion only via the catalogue in `docs/motion.md`.
- [ ] Copy follows `docs/voice.md` (verb-first buttons, ✓ feedback, no emoji).

## Docs map
`docs/principles.md` tone & mood · `docs/voice.md` conversation style · `docs/color.md` · `docs/typography.md` · `docs/layout.md` · `docs/motion.md` · `docs/components.md` (every class with HTML) · `docs/imagery.md` · `docs/frameworks.md` (Next, Svelte, Vue, Astro, Tailwind, plain HTML) · `docs/tokens.md` (generated). Skills: `skills/poiema-design`, `skills/poiema-voice`, `skills/poiema-review`.

---

## Working on this repository (not on an app)
- `src/tokens.json` is the single source for tokens. `src/css/*.css` holds components (each file declares its `@layer`). `src/js/poiema.js` holds behaviors (keep every export a top-level `export function`/`export const`; the auto build strips `export`).
- `npm run build` regenerates `dist/`, `docs/tokens.md`, the contrast table in `docs/color.md`, `skills/*/references/` and `llms-full.txt`. **Never edit generated files by hand.** Commit `dist/` (GitHub installs use it; there is no public CDN).
- `npm test` builds and runs `test/`. The build fails if a contrast pair in `src/tokens.json` drops below its threshold.
- New component: add CSS in the right file, document it in `docs/components.md` (HTML snippet), add it to the cheat-sheet above and to `demo/index.html`.
- After visual changes, refresh the README images with `npm run screenshots` (needs Playwright: `npm i --no-save playwright`). `screenshots/` is not shipped in the package.
- Releases come only from the **Release** workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, run from GitHub Actions): it bumps `package.json` and the plugin manifest, points install snippets at the new `#semver:` range, rebuilds, writes `CHANGELOG.md`, tags `vX.Y.Z` and publishes a GitHub release listing the commits since the last tag. Never bump the version, edit `CHANGELOG.md` or tag by hand. Bump `patch` for docs, skills and fixes, `minor` for new components or tokens, `major` for renamed or removed classes and tokens or rules that make agents rewrite existing screens (while on `0.x`, breaking changes go out as `minor`).
- Zero runtime dependencies. Keep it that way.


---

# Principles — tone & mood

> **Poiema** (ποίημα): *workmanship, something made*. The system grew out of the direction page for Poiema Conf 26. Its central image is material being formed: **clay → plaster → grass → iron → diamond**. The interface is the quiet studio, and the objects carry the transformation.

## The mood in one line

**A quiet gray gallery, huge confident lowercase type, and a few tactile objects floating in soft light. It is sincere and communal, and it never shouts in color.**

| It feels | It never feels |
|---|---|
| quiet, weighty, calm | loud, busy, "growth-hacky" |
| tactile and physical (objects, shadows, paper) | flat, glossy, neon, gradient-heavy |
| editorial and poster-like | dashboard-like, template-like |
| sincere and pastoral ("we", "our family") | salesy, ironic, jokey |
| clear and decisive | vague, hedging |
| contemporary and reverent | churchy-clichéd, or cold-corporate |

## The eight principles

### 1. Gray is the room; objects carry the color
Interface chrome is strictly **grayscale**: canvas `#e2e2e2`, paper `#f7f7f7`, ink `#2b2b2b`. Hue appears only inside **material objects** such as 3D renders, photos and the gem, and in the rare semantic state (danger = clay, success = grass). Never paint buttons, links or backgrounds with a hue.

### 2. Type does the shouting
Hierarchy comes from **scale, weight and tight tracking** in one family (Inter Tight). Headlines are huge, heavy (800), tightly tracked (-0.05em), **lowercase, and end with a period**: `watch first.` Everything around them is small and calm: 12px tracked uppercase eyebrows, 17px body.

### 3. Soft geometry
Every container is soft: **40px cards, pill buttons and chips, circular rings**. The only sharp shape is the small rotated-square **diamond** bullet, which echoes the gem. No 4px or 8px "app" corners on large surfaces.

### 4. One point per section
Each section makes one point, and its headline and first line carry it. Write for skimmers. The reference page, a briefing for leaders, repeated that point in an ink callout labeled *"the message that must be clear"*; Poiema products mostly speak to consumers, so add that callout only when someone asks for it.

### 5. Rhythm by inversion
Light cards and dark cards alternate. Ink boxes punctuate paper. A dark marquee band breaks the page. Contrast, not color, creates emphasis and pacing.

### 6. Numbers are structure
Content is a numbered journey: `00 watch first.` → `01` … `07`. Numbers sit in **rings**, the same drawing as the "26" badge of the logo. Dates are typographic: `13 · 14 · 15 nov`, `18.10.2026`.

### 7. Motion settles
Things **rise 28px and settle** (900ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`). Objects **float** on a slow 7s breath and tilt toward the pointer. Materials **cross-fade**. Nothing bounces, flashes or spins for fun, and everything respects reduced motion.

### 8. Freedom with clear boundaries
The voice separates **what must be kept** (✓ checks) from **what is up to you** (○ open circles). It explains the *why* behind every rule and trusts the reader.

## Do / don't

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| Use `--pm-canvas` gray as the page, paper cards on top | Use pure white `#fff` pages or colored backgrounds |
| One huge lowercase headline per section, ending in `.` | Title Case Headlines Or ALL CAPS HEADLINES |
| Make one phrase gray (`.pm-muted`) to create an echo: `from christ. <span class="pm-muted">in us.</span> to the world.` | Use color or underline for emphasis in display type |
| Put the main point in the headline and first line | Bury it mid-paragraph, or repeat it in a callout nobody asked for |
| Pills for actions, rings for numbers, diamonds for bullets | Square buttons, emoji bullets, icon-font clutter |
| Real objects with soft drop shadows, floating | Flat stock illustrations, glossy 3D blobs, gradients as decoration |
| Calm outlined alerts ("Attention", "Important") | Red/yellow alert banners and exclamation icons |
| Slow reveal on scroll and gentle float | Bouncy springs, parallax overload, auto-playing noise |

## When building something that isn't a church page
The system is not tied to its source. A dashboard, a store or a tool gets the same treatment: gray room, paper cards, ink actions, one big lowercase title per view, numbered steps in rings, and a single object (product shot, gem, photo) as the only color on screen.


---

# Voice — conversation style

The voice is a **pastor-editor**: warm, communal, sure of itself and brief. It speaks as **"we"** to **"our family"**, explains the *why*, draws clear boundaries and leaves room for freedom. Examples come in Portuguese (the brand's native language) and English. Apply the same rules in either.

## The ten patterns

### 1. Lowercase display headlines that end with a period
Headlines are statements, so they get a period. Questions keep their `?`.

| pt-BR | en |
|---|---|
| `assista primeiro.` | `watch first.` |
| `orientações gerais às lideranças.` | `general guidance for leaders.` |
| `por que não vamos divulgar o lineup?` | `why we won't announce the lineup?` |
| `suas tarefas de hoje.` | `your tasks for today.` |

Body text uses normal sentence case. Proper nouns stay capitalized in body copy and are lowercased only in display headlines (`o que é a poiema conference?`).

### 2. Triads with periods
Three short beats, each closed by a period. In display type the **middle beat goes gray** (`.pm-muted`), which creates the "echo."
- `de cristo. em nós. para o mundo.` / `from christ. in us. to the world.`
- In running text, use a comma triad: `com unidade, clareza e alinhamento` / `with unity, clarity and alignment`.
- App example: `plan. focus. finish.`

### 3. Reframe: "not X — Y"
Say what something is *not* before saying what it is. This is the signature rhetorical move.
- `Não é apenas uma programação de três dias. É um tempo de…` / `It isn't just a three-day schedule. It's a time of…`
- `Este material não é um roteiro de fala.` / `This isn't a script.`
- `Mais do que um evento, …` / `More than an event, …`
- `não apenas …, mas também …` / `not only …, but also …`

### 4. The message that must be clear (only on request)
The reference page briefed leaders, so each section closed with one or two sentences in a `.pm-callout` labeled **"Mensagem que precisa ficar clara"** / **"The message that must be clear"**. Poiema products mostly speak to consumers, so don't add it by default. When someone asks for it, keep it to one or two sentences that carry the point on their own.

### 5. Communal "we", warm and direct
Use `nós / nossa família / queremos / cremos` and `we / our family / we want / we believe`. Address the reader as a partner and never as a customer. No hype words ("incrível", "revolutionary", "🚀").

### 6. Freedom with boundaries
Split guidance explicitly into what must be kept (`.pm-list--check`) and what is up to the reader (`.pm-list--open`), then add one calm `.pm-alert` that guards the meaning:
> **Important.** Freedom in how you say it should not change what it means.

### 7. Calm alerts that explain
Alerts are titled with one uppercase word, **Atenção / Attention** or **Importante / Important**. They say what *not* to do and *why*, without blame and without exclamation marks.

### 8. Short verb-first actions, past-tense feedback
- Buttons: verb + object. `Baixar motions`, `Copiar informações`, `Assistir 2:43` / `Download files`, `Copy details`, `Watch 2:43`.
- Feedback: past participle + ✓. `Copiado ✓` / `Copied ✓`, `Salvo ✓` / `Saved ✓`.
- Failure: plain and blameless. `Não foi possível copiar` / `Couldn't copy`.
- Rich CTA subtitle: one line of *what you get*. `Pasta com os arquivos para cada telão` / `Folder with files for every screen`.

### 9. Typographic data
- Separate metadata with a middle dot and spaces: `Material interno · Poiemas`, `Tangaroa Hall · Taubaté`.
- Dates: `13 · 14 · 15 nov`, `18.10.2026`, `novembro · 2026`.
- Numbers are heroes: `19` (years), `26 dias` (countdown). Let one number be huge.
- Index steps with two digits in rings: `00`, `01` … `07`. `00` means "before everything".

### 10. Close with a couplet
End a page with an antithesis or anaphora pair, the one line people repeat:
- `Não venha por um nome. Venha por Jesus!` / `Don't come for a name. Come for Jesus!`
- App example: `Not more features. Fewer, better ones.`
The closing line is the only place an exclamation mark may appear.

## Microcopy kit (app contexts)

| Situation | pt-BR | en |
|---|---|---|
| Page title | `seus projetos.` | `your projects.` |
| Empty state title | `nada por aqui ainda.` | `nothing here yet.` |
| Empty state body | `Quando você criar o primeiro projeto, ele aparece aqui.` | `When you create your first project, it shows up here.` |
| Primary action | `Criar projeto` | `Create project` |
| Destructive confirm | `Excluir projeto?` + `Isso não pode ser desfeito.` | `Delete project?` + `This can't be undone.` |
| Success toast | `Projeto criado ✓` | `Project created ✓` |
| Error (form) | `Informe um e-mail válido.` | `Enter a valid email.` |
| Error (system) | `Algo não funcionou. Tente de novo em instantes.` | `Something didn't work. Try again in a moment.` |
| Loading | `Carregando…` | `Loading…` |
| Section eyebrow | `Passo 02 · Detalhes` | `Step 02 · Details` |
| Key-message callout label (on request) | `Mensagem que precisa ficar clara` | `The one thing to remember` |
| Onboarding step | `00 · comece por aqui.` | `00 · start here.` |

## Punctuation & casing rules
- Display headlines: lowercase, period at the end (or `?`).
- Eyebrows, tags and alert titles: UPPERCASE in CSS (`text-transform`), so write them in sentence case in the source.
- Buttons: Sentence case, no period.
- Body: sentence case, periods, `—` for asides, `…` for ellipsis.
- One `<strong>` per paragraph at most. It marks the phrase that must not be missed.
- No emoji. The only symbols are `·`, `✓`, `○`, `↗` and `—`.

## Self-check before shipping copy
1. Does every display headline end with `.` or `?` and stay lowercase?
2. Does each section's headline and first line carry its one point? (No key-message callout unless asked.)
3. Did you use "we/our" instead of "the company/users"?
4. Is any rhetorical "not X — Y" or triad doing real work, or is it decoration? Use them where they mean something, at most once or twice per page.
5. Are buttons verb-first, and does feedback use a past participle + ✓?
6. Zero hype words, zero emoji, at most one exclamation mark (the closing line).


---

# Color

**The interface is grayscale. Color lives in objects.** The grays are the exact values of the reference page. The five **materials** were sampled from its 3D gem renders: barro, gesso, grama, ferro, diamante.

## Neutrals — the room

| Role | Token | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page | `--pm-canvas` | `#e2e2e2` cool mid-gray | `#161616` |
| Paper (chips, inputs, bands) | `--pm-surface` | `#f7f7f7` | `#262626` |
| Panel / card base | `--pm-surface-2` | `#ececec` | `#1f1f1f` |
| Card fill | `--pm-card` | `linear-gradient(160deg, #fafafa, #ececec)` | `#1f1f1f` |
| Text, icons, solid buttons | `--pm-ink` | `#2b2b2b` | `#f7f7f7` |
| Body copy | `--pm-ink-2` | `#555555` | `#b9b9b9` |
| Small labels | `--pm-label` | `#646464` | `#9a9a9a` |
| Echo gray (large text only) | `--pm-muted` | `#7d7d7d` | `#8d8d8d` |
| Hairlines | `--pm-line` | `rgba(43,43,43,.14)` | `rgba(255,255,255,.12)` |

Pure white `#fff` appears only as the 1px top highlight on cards (`--pm-card-edge`). Pages are never white.

## Materials — the objects

| Material | pt-BR | Token | Light | Base | Deep |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clay | barro | `--pm-clay` | `#d47b4d` | `#b8562a` | `#903b14` |
| Plaster | gesso | `--pm-plaster` | `#edebe9` | `#cfcbc6` | `#a9a49d` |
| Grass | grama | `--pm-grass` | `#8aa83a` | `#4b650a` | `#2f4305` |
| Iron | ferro | `--pm-iron` | `#777164` | `#534d40` | `#2b261c` |
| Diamond | diamante | `--pm-diamond` | `#eef1f2` | `#c3c8ca` | `#8f989c` |

The order matters. It tells a story of **formation** (clay → diamond), so when you show all five, keep that sequence.

**Use materials for:** the gem and other illustrations, object renders, data-viz series, avatars and placeholders, a category dot.
**Never use materials for:** buttons, links, backgrounds, focus rings or borders of interactive UI.

### Semantic states
- `--pm-danger` (clay): errors and destructive actions. It's a warm earth tone, never alarm red. Pair it with text such as "Couldn't save", never color alone.
- `--pm-success` (grass): confirmations.
- No "warning" or "info" hue. Use a neutral `.pm-alert` with an uppercase title.

## Themes & inversion

- `data-theme="light" | "dark" | "auto"` on **any** element re-maps every semantic token for that subtree and paints it with `--pm-canvas`. Use it on `<html>` for the whole app, or on a single card for the dark-card rhythm. (`.pm-card` keeps its own card fill, `#1f1f1f` in dark.)
- `.pm-inverse` (built into `.pm-callout`, `.pm-marquee` and `.pm-ticket__main`) flips the foreground tokens and fills with ink: a **dark box on light pages and a paper box on dark cards**, automatically.
- Solid buttons use `--pm-ink` / `--pm-on-ink`, so they flip with the theme on their own.

## Accessibility

The build checks these pairs in both themes and fails if one regresses. `muted` is reserved for large display text, which needs 3:1. For small gray text, use `label` or `ink-2`. Small labels (`--pm-label`) are a little darker than the reference page's `#8a8a8a` so 12px uppercase text passes AA. Design tweak: the echo gray moved from `#8a8a8a` to `#7d7d7d` to pass 3:1 on the canvas.

<!-- contrast:start -->
| Foreground | Background | Light | Dark | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ink` | `canvas` | 10.93 | 16.89 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `ink` | `surface` | 13.22 | 14.13 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `ink` | `surface-2` | 11.99 | 15.39 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `ink-2` | `canvas` | 5.75 | 9.22 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `ink-2` | `surface` | 6.96 | 7.71 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `ink-2` | `surface-2` | 6.31 | 8.40 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `label` | `canvas` | 4.57 | 6.43 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `label` | `surface` | 5.52 | 5.38 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `label` | `surface-2` | 5.01 | 5.86 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `muted` | `canvas` | 3.18 | 5.45 | 3 (large text) |
| `muted` | `surface` | 3.84 | 4.56 | 3 (large text) |
| `muted` | `surface-2` | 3.48 | 4.97 | 3 (large text) |
| `on-ink` | `ink` | 13.22 | 13.22 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `on-ink-2` | `ink` | 7.22 | 6.96 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `on-ink-label` | `ink` | 5.03 | 5.52 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `on-ink-muted` | `ink` | 4.27 | 3.84 | 3 (large text) |
| `danger` | `canvas` | 5.75 | 5.81 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `danger` | `surface` | 6.95 | 4.86 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `success` | `canvas` | 6.05 | 6.67 | 4.5 (AA) |
| `success` | `surface` | 7.32 | 5.58 | 4.5 (AA) |
<!-- contrast:end -->

# Typography

**One family: [Inter Tight](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter+Tight)** (400–900). It's a narrow grotesk, and the tightness is the point. Weight, size and negative tracking carry all hierarchy. Fallback: `"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`.

## Loading the font
Pick one:
- **Google Fonts**: `@import "poiema-ui/fonts.css";` or `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">`
- **Self-hosted**: `npm i @fontsource-variable/inter-tight` then `import "@fontsource-variable/inter-tight"` (family `"Inter Tight Variable"` is already in the stack).
- **Next.js**: `next/font/google` → `Inter_Tight({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--pm-font-sans' })` and put the class on `<html>`.

## Scale

| Class | Size | Weight | Tracking | Leading | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.pm-lockup` | 92→290px | 800 | -0.055em | .8 | Hero wordmark only |
| `.pm-display` | 56→160px | 800 | -0.055em | .92 | Closing motto, one huge word |
| `.pm-numeral` | 76→168px | 900 | -0.07em | .8 | Dates, years, counts |
| `.pm-h1` | 40→88px | 800 | -0.05em | .92 | Section titles |
| `.pm-h2` | 34→58px | 800 | -0.05em | .95 | Card titles |
| `.pm-h3` | 26→44px | 700 | -0.035em | 1.14 | **Statements**: a full sentence set big |
| `.pm-h4` | 20→26px | 800 | -0.035em | 1.1 | Tile titles, ticket values |
| `.pm-lead` | 16→19px | 400 | 0 | 1.6 | Intro paragraph (ink-2, strong = ink) |
| body | 17px (16 mobile) | 400 | 0 | 1.6 | Everything else |
| `.pm-eyebrow` | 12px | 700 | +0.14em | 1.4 | UPPERCASE labels above titles |
| `.pm-tag` | 11px | 700 | +0.10em | 1.2 | Outlined pill label |

## Rules
1. **Display text is lowercase and ends with a period.** Write it lowercase in the source, or use `.pm-lower` for CMS content.
2. **The echo:** wrap one phrase of a display line in `.pm-muted`, usually the middle beat of a triad or the last words of a quote: `a mensagem sempre foi maior do que <span class="pm-muted">o mensageiro.</span>`
3. **Negative tracking grows with size.** Body is 0, titles -0.035em, headlines -0.05em, numerals -0.07em. Never track body text.
4. **Uppercase only for small labels**, always tracked +0.10 to +0.14em, always bold.
5. **Weights:** 400 body · 600 nav/chips · 700 labels, strong, statements · 800 headlines · 900 numerals. Avoid 300 and lighter.
6. **`<strong>` is ink, the surrounding body is ink-2.** That contrast is how emphasis reads. Use one per paragraph.
7. **Balance headlines** (`text-wrap: balance`, applied automatically) and cap them with `max-width: 14ch` in narrow columns.
8. **Tabular numbers** for times, counters and tables (`.pm-nums`).


---

# Layout, surfaces & spacing

## Grid & rhythm
- **Container:** `.pm-container`, 1180px max with a fluid gutter of `clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px)`.
- **Sections:** `.pm-section` adds half of `clamp(64px, 9vw, 120px)` above and below, so sections stack with one full gap.
- **Cards** pad `clamp(28px, 5.5vw, 72px)`, which is generous. Content never touches a card's edge.
- **Gaps between cards** are small (16–20px). Cards read as a stack of plates, not a grid of tiles.
- **Breakpoints:** 900px (columns collapse) and 560px (type and padding shrink).

## Space scale
4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 20 · 24 · 28 · 32 · 40 · 48 · 56 · 64 · 72 · 96 · 120 (`--pm-space-1` … `--pm-space-30`). Typical values: 8 between chips, 12–16 between list items and tiles, 28 between a title and its body, 36 under a section head.

## Radii

| Token | px | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `--pm-radius-xl` | 40 | **Signature.** Cards, frames, tickets, dialogs, dark sections |
| `--pm-radius-lg` | 28 | Callouts |
| `--pm-radius-md` | 24 | Alerts, tiles, textareas, mobile frames |
| `--pm-radius-sm` | 14 | Inner screens, skeletons |
| `--pm-radius-xs` | 7 | Checkboxes |
| `--pm-radius-pill` | 999 | Buttons, chips, tags, inputs, nav pills |

## Elevation
Depth comes from **light, not borders**:
1. Canvas (gray), then card (lighter paper gradient with a 1px white top highlight), then chip or input (paper).
2. Objects get a **drop-shadow** (`filter: drop-shadow(var(--pm-shadow-object))`) because they are cut-outs, not boxes.
3. Frames and tickets get one big soft shadow (`--pm-shadow-float`: `0 40px 90px -40px`).
4. Hairline outlines (`--pm-line`) mark "soft" or optional areas: outlined cards, tiles, inputs.

## Page anatomy (the reference page, generalized)

```
topbar        brand ············································ [TAG · CONTEXT]
hero          EYEBROW · DATE
              lockup / display headline
              (chip) (chip) (solid chip)
              lead paragraph with one strong phrase
              scroll cue
marquee       short phrase · object · short phrase · object …   (ink band)
section 00    (00) huge lowercase title.  + lead
              media frame / primary content
section       dark card: text + rich CTA  |  visual
section       ruled split: big statement  |  "not a script" stamp + body
pill nav      (01) a  (02) b  (03) c …                           (sticky)
features      card: object | (01) title + diamonds + callout
              dark card: huge numeral | (02) title + list + paper callout
              card (full): trio of objects with captions + split list | callout
              …
section 07    (07) title. → ticket (dark stub | paper rows) → hint + copy button
section       (—) title. → card: ✓ must keep  | outlined card: ○ your call + alert
band          EYEBROW · centered statement · five materials floating · motto
footer        dark, centered, small
```

Use what you need. An app screen is usually: topbar → `.pm-section-head` (ring + lowercase title + lead) → cards.


---

# Motion

**Things arrive and settle. Objects breathe. Materials transform.** Motion is slow, physical and sparse. Use it to reveal and to give weight, never to entertain.

## The house curve
`--pm-ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1)` ("settle"): a fast start and a long, soft landing. Use it for every movement except the float (`ease-in-out`) and the marquee (`linear`).

## Durations

| Token | ms | For |
|---|---|---|
| `--pm-dur-fast` | 200 | hover lift, color/background changes |
| `--pm-dur-base` | 300 | controls appearing, dialogs, toasts, rich-button hover |
| `--pm-dur-slow` | 700 | cross-fade opacity |
| `--pm-dur-reveal` | 900 | scroll reveal |
| `--pm-dur-swap` | 1000 | material swap transform |

## The catalogue

| Motion | How | Values |
|---|---|---|
| **Reveal** | `data-pm-reveal` (JS) | opacity 0→1, translateY 28px→0, 900ms settle, once, at 10% visible |
| **Stagger** | `data-pm-stagger` on a parent (JS) | children reveal 80ms apart |
| **Float** | `.pm-float` (+ `.pm-float-group`) | translate 0 → -10px → 0 over 7s, ease-in-out, siblings offset -1.2s |
| **Tilt** | `data-pm-tilt` on a wrapper (JS) | first child: perspective 700px, ±9° on X/Y following the pointer, scale 1.04, 250ms ease-out. Hover devices only. |
| **Material swap** | `data-pm-cycle` (JS) | stacked children; outgoing → opacity 0, scale .9, rotate -8°; incoming → none. Every 1.8s. |
| **Marquee** | `.pm-marquee` | track moves -50% in 40s linear, content rendered twice, pauses on hover |
| **Lift** | `.pm-btn`, `.pm-lift` | translateY -2px (rich CTA -3px plus a stronger shadow), 200ms settle |
| **Nudge** | `.pm-btn__arrow`, `.pm-btn__icon svg` | ↗ moves (3px, -3px); download icon moves down 2px |
| **Scroll cue** | `.pm-scroll-cue` | a dot drops inside a mouse outline, 1.8s loop |
| **Copy feedback** | `data-pm-copy` (JS) | label swaps to "Copied ✓" for 2.2s |
| **Dialog / toast** | `.pm-dialog`, `toast()` | rise 28px + fade, 300ms settle |
| **Sticky glass** | `.pm-topbar` | `backdrop-filter: blur(14px)` over 80% canvas |

## Rules
1. **Reveal containers, not atoms.** Put `data-pm-reveal` on sections and cards, not on every paragraph or button.
2. **Float only objects** (cut-out images, the gem), never text or cards.
3. **One looping thing per viewport.** A floating object or a marquee is enough. Don't stack loops.
4. **No bounce, no overshoot, no spin** (except the loading spinner).
5. **Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.** Already handled: reveals show instantly, loops stop, tilt is disabled. If you write new motion, add it to the reduced-motion block.
6. Hover effects only on `(hover: hover)` devices when they rely on the pointer (tilt).

## Without JS
All CSS motion (float, marquee, lift, nudge, scroll cue, dialog/toast transitions) works without JavaScript. JS-driven content (`data-pm-reveal`) is hidden only when scripting is enabled, and a CSS failsafe reveals it after 2.5s if `init()` never runs.


---

# Components

Plain HTML + `pm-*` classes. They work in any framework: rename `class` → `className` in JSX. Behaviors marked **[JS]** need `init()` from `poiema-ui` (or the auto script). Everything else is CSS only.

## Contents
Typography · Ring · Lockup · Chips & tags · Buttons · Cards · Feature · Section head · Callout · Alert · Lists · Pill nav · Topbar · Hero · Marquee · Object & frame · Stat · Ticket · Table · Forms · Dialog · Toast · Progress, spinner, skeleton · Footer · Layout helpers · Utilities

---

## Typography
```html
<p class="pm-eyebrow">Step 02 · Details</p>
<h1 class="pm-h1">your projects.</h1>
<h2 class="pm-h2">what is a project?</h2>
<p class="pm-h3">A project is <span class="pm-muted">a place</span> for everything one goal needs.</p>
<h4 class="pm-h4">Weekly review</h4>
<p class="pm-lead">A guide so every team ships with <strong>unity, clarity and alignment</strong>.</p>
<p class="pm-display">plan. <span class="pm-muted">focus.</span> finish.</p>
<span class="pm-numeral">19</span>
```
`.pm-prose` styles raw markdown/CMS HTML (h1–h4, p, ul with diamonds, ol with rings, blockquote, code, pre, hr).

## Ring
The circled number. Use it for steps, section indexes and badges. Sizes: `--sm` 26px, default 52px (44px on mobile), `--lg` 72px.
```html
<span class="pm-ring">01</span>
<span class="pm-ring pm-ring--sm">03</span>
<span class="pm-ring">—</span>   <!-- unnumbered section -->
```

## Lockup (hero wordmark)
Small word on top, huge word below, an object replacing one letter, and a ringed badge. For one hero per product.
```html
<h1 class="pm-lockup" aria-label="poiema conf 26">
  <span class="pm-lockup__top">poiema</span>
  <span class="pm-lockup__main">
    <span>c</span>
    <span class="pm-lockup__object" data-pm-cycle aria-hidden="true">   <!-- [JS] material swap -->
      <svg style="color:var(--pm-clay)">…gem…</svg>
      <svg style="color:var(--pm-diamond)">…gem…</svg>
    </span>
    <span>nf</span>
    <span class="pm-lockup__badge">26</span>
  </span>
</h1>
```

## Chips & tags
```html
<span class="pm-chip">13 · 14 · 15 nov</span>
<span class="pm-chip pm-chip--solid"><b>26</b> days</span>
<span class="pm-chip pm-chip--outline">Draft</span>
<span class="pm-tag">Internal · Team</span>
```

## Buttons
Solid buttons use ink, so they are dark on light surfaces and paper on dark cards automatically.
```html
<button class="pm-btn">Create project</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--soft">Cancel</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--outline">Preview</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--ghost">Skip</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--danger">Delete</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--sm">Small</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--lg pm-btn--block">Large, full width</button>
<button class="pm-btn pm-btn--icon" aria-label="Close">✕</button>

<!-- Rich CTA: one per screen, for the main download / next step -->
<a class="pm-btn pm-btn--rich" href="…">
  <span class="pm-btn__icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v11M7 10l5 5 5-5M5 20h14"/></svg></span>
  <span class="pm-btn__text"><b>Download files</b><small>Folder with files for every screen</small></span>
  <span class="pm-btn__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
</a>
<!-- add pm-btn--soft for a paper rich CTA on a light page -->

<!-- [JS] copy with feedback -->
<button class="pm-btn" data-pm-copy="Text to copy" data-pm-copied="Copied ✓">Copy details</button>
<button class="pm-btn" data-pm-copy-target="#details">Copy details</button>
```
`.pm-play` is a round paper play button (for media covers).

## Cards
```html
<article class="pm-card">…</article>                         <!-- paper gradient, 40px radius -->
<article class="pm-card" data-theme="dark">…</article>       <!-- deep ink card: alternate for rhythm -->
<article class="pm-card pm-card--outline">…</article>        <!-- transparent, hairline: "optional/soft" -->
<article class="pm-card pm-card--compact">…</article>        <!-- smaller padding -->
<a class="pm-card" href="…">…</a>                            <!-- clickable: lifts on hover -->

<div class="pm-tile">                                         <!-- small outlined box -->
  <span class="pm-eyebrow">Current series</span>
  <strong class="pm-tile__title">Acts 29</strong>
  <p>Understanding the identity and mission of the church.</p>
</div>
```

## Feature (object + content card)
```html
<article class="pm-card pm-feature" data-pm-reveal>
  <div class="pm-feature__media" data-pm-tilt>                  <!-- [JS] tilt -->
    <img class="pm-object pm-float" src="object.png" alt="…">
  </div>
  <div class="pm-feature__body">
    <span class="pm-ring">01</span>
    <h2 class="pm-h2">what is a project?</h2>
    <ul class="pm-list">…</ul>
  </div>
</article>
```
`.pm-feature--flip` puts the media on the right (alternate every other card). Columns collapse under 900px.

## Section head
```html
<header class="pm-section-head">
  <span class="pm-ring">00</span>
  <h2 class="pm-h1">watch first.</h2>
  <p>Understand why we're doing this and how to use the steps below.</p>
</header>
```
Without a ring it becomes a single column.

## Callout: "the message that must be clear"
Inverted ink box. It is dark on light cards and paper on dark cards, automatically. Use it only when someone asks for a key message: it comes from a leaders' briefing, and consumer screens don't close sections with it.
```html
<div class="pm-callout">
  <span class="pm-eyebrow">The message that must be clear</span>
  <p>It isn't just a three-day schedule. It's a time to gather, grow and get direction.</p>
  <p class="pm-callout__big">Don't come for a name. Come for Jesus!</p>  <!-- optional closer -->
</div>
```
`.pm-inverse` gives any element the same flip.

## Alert
Calm and outlined. The title is one word.
```html
<div class="pm-alert" role="note">
  <strong class="pm-alert__title">Attention</strong>
  <p>Don't present this as a critique of other teams. It's a direction for us, this year.</p>
</div>
<div class="pm-alert pm-alert--danger" role="alert">…</div>
<div class="pm-alert pm-alert--success" role="status">…</div>
```

## Lists
```html
<ul class="pm-list">…</ul>                 <!-- ◆ diamonds (default) -->
<ul class="pm-list pm-list--check">…</ul>  <!-- ✓ what must be kept -->
<ul class="pm-list pm-list--open">…</ul>   <!-- ○ what is up to you -->
<ol class="pm-list pm-list--numbered">…</ol> <!-- 01 02 03 in small rings -->
```
Items are ink-2; `<strong>` inside them is ink.

## Pill nav (index, tabs, filters)
```html
<nav class="pm-pillnav pm-pillnav--sticky" aria-label="Sections">
  <a href="#b1"><span class="pm-ring pm-ring--sm">01</span> overview</a>
  <a href="#b2" aria-current="true"><span class="pm-ring pm-ring--sm">02</span> details</a>
</nav>
<div class="pm-pillnav" role="tablist">
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="true">All</button>
  <button role="tab" aria-selected="false">Drafts</button>
</div>
```
Active = `aria-current`, `aria-selected="true"` or `aria-pressed="true"` (ink fill). Hover is a quiet line tint, so only the active pill looks selected.

## Topbar
```html
<header class="pm-topbar">
  <a class="pm-topbar__brand" href="/">poiema</a>
  <nav class="pm-topbar__nav"><a href="/projects" aria-current="page">projects</a><a href="/team">team</a></nav>
  <span class="pm-tag">Internal · Team</span>
</header>
```
Sticky, 80% canvas glass with a 14px blur. Its height is `--pm-sticky-top` (58px), and sticky children offset by it.

## Hero
```html
<section class="pm-hero pm-hero--pillars">
  <p class="pm-eyebrow">Communication guide · 18.10.2026</p>
  <h1 class="pm-lockup">…</h1>                      <!-- or .pm-display -->
  <div class="pm-cluster pm-cluster--center">
    <span class="pm-chip">13 · 14 · 15 nov</span>
    <span class="pm-chip pm-chip--solid"><b>26</b> days</span>
  </div>
  <p class="pm-lead">A guide so every team speaks with <strong>unity, clarity and alignment</strong>.</p>
  <a class="pm-scroll-cue" href="#next" aria-label="Scroll"></a>
</section>
```
`--pillars` adds the two glowing light capsules on the sides, always behind the content (`.pm-hero` is its own stacking context).

## Marquee
Render the group **twice**; the second copy is `aria-hidden`. Loops in 40s and pauses on hover.
```html
<div class="pm-marquee" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="pm-marquee__track">
    <div class="pm-marquee__group"><span>from christ.</span><img src="gem.svg" alt=""><span class="pm-muted">in us.</span><img …><span>to the world.</span><img …></div>
    <div class="pm-marquee__group"><!-- exact same content --></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Object & frame
```html
<img class="pm-object pm-float" src="medal.png" alt="…">     <!-- cut-out + soft shadow + float -->
<div class="pm-float-group">…objects…</div>                   <!-- staggered floating -->
<div class="pm-frame">
  <video …></video>
  <button class="pm-frame__cover"><span class="pm-play"></span><span class="pm-eyebrow">Watch 2:43</span></button>
</div>
```
Assets: `poiema-ui/assets/gem.svg` (uses `currentColor`; inline it and set `color: var(--pm-clay)` etc.).

## Stat
```html
<div class="pm-stat"><strong class="pm-stat__value">26</strong><span class="pm-stat__label">days to go</span></div>
<div class="pm-stat pm-stat--stacked"><span class="pm-numeral">19</span><span class="pm-stat__label">years<br>15.11.2026</span></div>
```

## Ticket
For events, plans, receipts or summaries. The dark stub flips to paper in dark mode.
```html
<div class="pm-ticket">
  <div class="pm-ticket__main">
    <p class="pm-eyebrow">poiema conference</p>
    <div class="pm-ticket__dates"><span>13</span><span>14</span><span>15</span></div>  <!-- middle one is muted -->
    <p class="pm-ticket__month">november · 2026</p>
  </div>
  <div class="pm-ticket__side">
    <div class="pm-ticket__row"><span>Venue</span><strong>Tangaroa Hall</strong></div>
    <div class="pm-ticket__row"><span>City</span><strong>Taubaté, SP</strong></div>
    <div class="pm-ticket__row"><div class="pm-stat"><strong class="pm-stat__value" data-pm-countdown="2026-11-13T00:00:00-03:00">—</strong><span class="pm-stat__label">days to go</span></div></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
The notches use `--pm-notch` (default `--pm-canvas`). Set it to the ticket's real background if different.

## Table
```html
<div class="pm-table-wrap"><table class="pm-table">
  <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Status</th><th class="pm-num">Total</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody><tr><td>Lisbon trip</td><td>Planned</td><td class="pm-num">1,240</td></tr></tbody>
</table></div>
```

## Forms
```html
<label class="pm-field">
  <span class="pm-label">Email</span>
  <input class="pm-input" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com">
  <span class="pm-hint">We only use it for the confirmation.</span>
</label>
<label class="pm-field">
  <span class="pm-label">Team</span>
  <select class="pm-select"><option>Design</option></select>
</label>
<label class="pm-field">
  <span class="pm-label">Message</span>
  <textarea class="pm-textarea" aria-invalid="true"></textarea>
  <span class="pm-error">Write at least one sentence.</span>
</label>
<div class="pm-input-group"><input class="pm-input" placeholder="Search"><button class="pm-btn">Search</button></div>

<label class="pm-choice"><input class="pm-check" type="checkbox" checked> Keep me posted</label>
<label class="pm-choice"><input class="pm-radio" type="radio" name="r" checked> Monthly</label>
<label class="pm-choice"><input class="pm-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch"> Dark mode</label>
```
Invalid state: `aria-invalid="true"` (clay border). Focus: 2px ink ring. The checked radio is the brand ring.

## Dialog
Native `<dialog>`. [JS] `data-pm-open="id"` opens it, a backdrop click closes it, and `[data-pm-close]` or `<form method="dialog">` closes it.
```html
<button class="pm-btn" data-pm-open="confirm">Delete</button>
<dialog class="pm-dialog" id="confirm">
  <div class="pm-stack pm-stack--lg">
    <h2 class="pm-h2">delete project?</h2>
    <p class="pm-body">This can't be undone.</p>
    <div class="pm-cluster"><button class="pm-btn pm-btn--danger" data-pm-close>Delete</button><button class="pm-btn pm-btn--soft" data-pm-close>Cancel</button></div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

## Toast
```js
import { toast } from 'poiema-ui';
toast('Project created ✓');
```

## Progress, spinner, skeleton
```html
<progress class="pm-progress" value="40" max="100"></progress>
<span class="pm-spinner" aria-label="Loading"></span>
<span class="pm-skeleton" style="width: 60%; height: 18px"></span>
```

## Footer
```html
<footer class="pm-footer" data-theme="dark">
  <strong class="pm-topbar__brand">poiema</strong>
  <p>Poiema · Internal use</p>
</footer>
```

## Layout helpers
| Class | Does |
|---|---|
| `.pm-container` (`--narrow`) | 1180px (820px) centered with fluid gutter |
| `.pm-section` | vertical rhythm block |
| `.pm-band` | full-width paper band (add `data-theme="dark"` for ink) |
| `.pm-stack` (`--xs --sm --lg --xl`) | vertical flex with gap 8/12/16/28/48 |
| `.pm-cluster` (`--between --center`) | wrapping row |
| `.pm-grid` (`--2 --3`) | auto-fit grid (min `--pm-min`, 280px) / fixed columns |
| `.pm-split` (`--even --top --center`) | 1.35fr / 1fr asymmetric columns |
| `.pm-ruled`, `.pm-rule` | 2px ink top rule opening a block |

Override any gap with `style="--pm-gap: 24px"`.

## Utilities
`.pm-ink .pm-ink-2 .pm-muted .pm-danger .pm-success .pm-lower .pm-upper .pm-nums .pm-balance .pm-center .pm-measure .pm-sr-only .pm-lift .pm-inverse`

## Behaviors [JS]

| Attribute | Behavior | Action function |
|---|---|---|
| `data-pm-reveal` (`="fade"`, `="scale"`) | rise and fade on scroll, once | `reveal(el, opts)` |
| `data-pm-stagger` | children reveal 80ms apart | `stagger(el, opts)` |
| `data-pm-tilt` | first child tilts toward the pointer | `tilt(el, {max, scale})` |
| `data-pm-cycle="1800"` | children cross-fade in turn | `cycle(el, {interval})` |
| `data-pm-copy="text"` / `data-pm-copy-target="#id"` | copy + "Copied ✓" | `copy(el, opts)` |
| `data-pm-countdown="ISO date"` | writes days left | `countdown(el)` / `daysUntil(date)` |
| `data-pm-open="dialogId"` | opens a `<dialog>` | `opener(el)` |
| `dialog.pm-dialog` | backdrop click + `[data-pm-close]` | `dialog(el)` |


---

# Imagery

The interface is gray, and **imagery is where the material and the color live**. The reference page uses two families of objects. Both are physical, studio-lit and cut out on transparent backgrounds.

1. **Materials:** one gem shape rendered in five materials: clay (barro), plaster (gesso), grass (grama), iron (ferro), diamond (diamante). Together they tell a story of formation.
2. **Medals and plaques:** aged-silver coins and tags, embossed with a simple symbol and a reference line (like `EPHESIANS 2:10`). They read as tokens of meaning.

## Rules
- **Cut-out objects, not scenes.** Use transparent PNG/WebP or SVG with no background or frame, centered, with breathing room.
- **Soft studio light from the top left** and a long soft shadow below. In CSS: `.pm-object` (drop-shadow `0 30px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.22)`).
- **Real materials:** matte, tactile, slightly imperfect (clay grain, plaster dust, grass blades, rusted iron, clear crystal). No plastic gloss, chrome reflections or neon.
- **Muted, earthy color.** Objects may carry color; the UI never does.
- **One object per idea.** A card gets one object. A trio gets three, and the closing band gets the five materials in order.
- **Animate gently:** `.pm-float`, `data-pm-tilt`, and `data-pm-cycle` to swap materials.
- **Photos** sit inside `.pm-frame` (40px radius, big soft shadow) with warm, natural light and real people. Avoid stock poses.

## The gem asset
`poiema-ui/assets/gem.svg` is a flat, faceted diamond that uses `currentColor`, an original stand-in for the 3D renders. Inline it and color it with a material token:
```html
<span style="color: var(--pm-grass)"><!-- paste gem.svg markup --></span>
```

## Prompt recipe (image generators)
> A single [OBJECT] made of [MATERIAL: weathered terracotta clay | raw white plaster | dense living moss and grass | rusted cast iron | clear faceted crystal], isolated on a transparent background, soft diffused studio light from top left, long soft shadow beneath, matte tactile surface with fine natural imperfections, centered, three-quarter view, photorealistic 3D render, muted natural color, no text, no background, no reflections of a room.

For medals:
> An aged silver medal/plaque with an embossed minimal symbol of [SYMBOL] and the small engraved caption "[REFERENCE]", irregular hand-cast edges, oxidized recesses, isolated on transparent background, soft top-left studio light, photorealistic 3D render.


---

# Using it in any stack

The system is **CSS-first**. Every framework just imports a stylesheet and writes `pm-*` classes. The optional JS is a set of tiny element behaviors with the shape `behavior(el, opts) → { destroy() }`.

## Install

```bash
npm i github:Poiema-Tech/poiema-ui#semver:^0.2.1
```
The `#semver:` range takes the newest release it allows; `npm update poiema-ui` moves within it, and `CHANGELOG.md` (in an app: `node_modules/poiema-ui/CHANGELOG.md`) says what each release changed. No build step. `dist/` is committed. The repository is **private and proprietary** (see `LICENSE`): the machine installing it needs GitHub access (SSH key or `gh auth login`; a read-only deploy key or token in CI), and the package is never published to npm or a public CDN.

Then, optionally, give your coding agent the context:
```bash
npx poiema-ui init      # copies skills to .claude/skills and adds a Poiema section to AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
```
Add `"postinstall": "poiema-ui init"` to the app's scripts so the skills follow every update.

## Plain HTML / any server-rendered app (Rails, Django, Laravel, Go, PHP…)
Copy `dist/poiema.min.css` and `dist/poiema.auto.js` (from the repo or `node_modules/poiema-ui/dist/`) into the app's static folder:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/vendor/poiema/poiema.min.css">
<script defer src="/vendor/poiema/poiema.auto.js"></script>
```
The auto script calls `init()` on load, watches the DOM, and exposes `window.Poiema` (`Poiema.toast('Saved ✓')`). There is no public CDN, on purpose.

## Next.js (App Router) / React
```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import 'poiema-ui/css';
import { Inter_Tight } from 'next/font/google';
import { PoiemaBehaviors } from './poiema-behaviors';

const font = Inter_Tight({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--pm-font-sans' });

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={font.variable}>
      <body>{children}<PoiemaBehaviors /></body>
    </html>
  );
}
```
```tsx
// app/poiema-behaviors.tsx
'use client';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { init } from 'poiema-ui';
export function PoiemaBehaviors() {
  useEffect(() => init(), []);   // watches the DOM, so client navigation is covered
  return null;
}
```
Per element instead: `useEffect(() => { const h = tilt(ref.current!); return h.destroy; }, [])`.
Use `daysUntil()` in render rather than `data-pm-countdown` (React owns the text node). Toasts: `import { toast } from 'poiema-ui'`.

## SvelteKit / Svelte
```svelte
<!-- +layout.svelte -->
<script>
  import 'poiema-ui/css';
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { init } from 'poiema-ui';
  onMount(() => init());
</script>
<slot />
```
Or use the behaviors as **actions**, since they have the exact action signature:
```svelte
<script> import { reveal, tilt, cycle } from 'poiema-ui'; </script>
<article class="pm-card" data-pm-reveal use:reveal>…</article>
<div class="pm-feature__media" use:tilt={{ max: 6 }}>…</div>
```
Keep the `data-pm-reveal` attribute in the markup so SSR'd content starts hidden.

## Vue / Nuxt
```js
// main.js / a Nuxt client plugin
import 'poiema-ui/css';
import { init, reveal } from 'poiema-ui';
app.mount('#app');
init();
// or as a directive:
app.directive('reveal', { mounted: (el) => (el._pm = reveal(el)), unmounted: (el) => el._pm?.destroy() });
```

## Astro
```astro
---
import 'poiema-ui/css';
---
<script> import { init } from 'poiema-ui'; init(); </script>
```

## Tailwind CSS v4
```css
/* app.css */
@layer theme, base, poiema, components, utilities;
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "poiema-ui/tailwind.css";   /* tokens → theme: bg-canvas text-ink-2 rounded-card text-h1 tracking-display shadow-float animate-float ease-settle … */
@import "poiema-ui/poiema.css";     /* optional: the pm-* components */
```
- The first line places Poiema **below** Tailwind utilities, so `class="pm-btn px-10"` works as expected.
- Tailwind's default palette is **removed** on purpose. Only brand colors exist: `canvas surface surface-2 ink ink-strong ink-2 label muted line line-strong on-ink danger success`, the `gray-*` scale and the materials `clay plaster grass iron diamond` (+ `-light`/`-deep`).
- Type utilities bundle size, line-height, tracking and weight: `text-h1`, `text-h2`, `text-h3`, `text-h4`, `text-display`, `text-numeral`, `text-lead`, `text-eyebrow` (add `uppercase`).

## Tokens in JS (charts, canvas, emails)
```js
import { tokens, cssVar } from 'poiema-ui/tokens';
tokens.color.light.ink       // "#2b2b2b"
tokens.primitives.clay       // "#b8562a"
cssVar('ink')                // "var(--pm-ink)"
```
`poiema-ui/tokens.json` holds the same data for non-JS tools (Figma plugins, Style Dictionary, native apps).

## Theming
```html
<html data-theme="light">  <!-- default; "dark" or "auto" (follows OS) -->
<article class="pm-card" data-theme="dark">  <!-- any subtree -->
```
To rebrand, override semantic tokens after the import (unlayered CSS always wins):
```css
:root { --pm-canvas: #e6e4e1; --pm-radius-xl: 32px; }
```

## Imports cheat-sheet
| Import | What |
|---|---|
| `poiema-ui/css` (`/poiema.css`, `/poiema.min.css`) | everything: tokens + base + components + motion |
| `poiema-ui/tokens.css` | only the custom properties |
| `poiema-ui/tailwind.css` | Tailwind v4 theme (includes tokens) |
| `poiema-ui/fonts.css` | Inter Tight from Google Fonts |
| `poiema-ui` | JS behaviors (ESM, typed) |
| `poiema-ui/auto` | classic script: auto-init + `window.Poiema` |
| `poiema-ui/tokens`, `/tokens.json` | tokens as data |
| `poiema-ui/assets/gem.svg` | the gem |


---

# Token reference

> Generated from `src/tokens.json` by `npm run build`. Do not edit by hand.

Every token is a CSS custom property. Use semantic colors (`--pm-ink`, `--pm-canvas`…), never primitives, in components.

## Semantic colors

| Variable | Light | Dark | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pm-canvas` | `#e2e2e2` | `#161616` | Page background. Cool, quiet mid-gray — never pure white. |
| `--pm-surface` | `#f7f7f7` | `#262626` | Raised small things: chips, pills, inputs, nav pills, soft buttons, bands. |
| `--pm-surface-2` | `#ececec` | `#1f1f1f` | Panels and the solid base of cards. |
| `--pm-card` | `linear-gradient(160deg, #fafafa, #ececec)` | `#1f1f1f` | Card fill. Light: soft paper gradient. Dark: solid deep ink. |
| `--pm-card-edge` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .04)` | 1px top highlight that makes cards feel lit from above. |
| `--pm-ink` | `#2b2b2b` | `#f7f7f7` | Primary text, icons, solid buttons, strong rules. |
| `--pm-ink-strong` | `#1f1f1f` | `#ffffff` | Rare extra-strong text. |
| `--pm-ink-2` | `#555555` | `#b9b9b9` | Body copy, list items, descriptions. |
| `--pm-label` | `#646464` | `#9a9a9a` | Small uppercase eyebrows and field labels (AA at 12px). |
| `--pm-muted` | `#7d7d7d` | `#8d8d8d` | The 'echo' gray inside display text (em nós.). Large text only. |
| `--pm-line` | `rgba(43, 43, 43, .14)` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, .12)` | Hairlines, outlined cards, input borders. |
| `--pm-line-strong` | `#2b2b2b` | `#555555` | Outlined alerts, tags, checkbox borders. |
| `--pm-perforation` | `#bdbdbd` | `#4a4a4a` | Dashed ticket perforation. |
| `--pm-on-ink` | `#f7f7f7` | `#2b2b2b` | Text on an ink fill (solid buttons, callouts). |
| `--pm-on-ink-2` | `#b9b9b9` | `#555555` | Secondary text on an ink fill. |
| `--pm-on-ink-label` | `#9a9a9a` | `#646464` | Labels on an ink fill. |
| `--pm-on-ink-muted` | `#8d8d8d` | `#7d7d7d` | Echo gray on an ink fill (large text). |
| `--pm-on-ink-line` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, .16)` | `rgba(43, 43, 43, .14)` | Hairlines on an ink fill. |
| `--pm-inverse-bg` | `#2b2b2b` | `#f7f7f7` | Fill of .pm-inverse regions (= ink, but safe to read inside the region). |
| `--pm-inverse-fg` | `#f7f7f7` | `#2b2b2b` | Text of .pm-inverse regions. |
| `--pm-glass` | `rgba(226, 226, 226, .8)` | `rgba(22, 22, 22, .78)` | Blurred sticky bars. |
| `--pm-scrim` | `rgba(20, 20, 20, .38)` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, .6)` | Dialog backdrop. |
| `--pm-pillar` | `.92` | `.07` | Strength (alpha) of the white light-pillars on the hero sides. |
| `--pm-danger` | `#903b14` | `#d47b4d` | Errors and destructive actions. Clay — warm, never alarm-red. |
| `--pm-success` | `#3f5a08` | `#8aa83a` | Confirmations. Grass. |
| `--pm-icon-check` | *(svg)* | *(svg)* | Checkbox tick (on-ink colored). |
| `--pm-icon-chevron` | *(svg)* | *(svg)* | Select chevron (ink colored). |

## Font

| Variable | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `--pm-font-sans` | `"Inter Tight", "Inter Tight Variable", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` | The only typeface. Tight grotesk; weight does all the hierarchy work. |
| `--pm-font-mono` | `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |  |

## Breakpoints

Documentation only — CSS custom properties cannot be used in media queries.

| Name | Value |
|---|---|
| md | `max-width: 900px` |
| sm | `max-width: 560px` |
